text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Egyptian President Mubarak: any aggression on Syria endangers whole region.
- Syrian Foreign Minister Shara confers with counterparts in Jakarta.
- Israeli foreign minister Levy reiterates rejection of full withdrawal from Golan.
- U.S., France say Israeli settlements dangerous for peace process.
- EU envoy voices support for Lebanon.
- Bashar al-Assad, son of Syrian president and head of Syria's computer society, attends closing session of symposium on arabisation and computers.
- Assistant Secretary-General of Syria's Baath party meets chairman of south Lebanon council.
- Syria's Prime Minister Zu'bi on official visit to China.
- Israeli police surround occupied Golan town of Majdal and seize cars.
